Great Banh Mi but not the best
Oct 2019 • Couples
We heard so much about this Banh Mi place on TripAdvisor and put this place in our must visit restaurant in Hanoi. When we got there, there were so many people lining up for the sandwich. We finally found a place in one of their second floor restaurants. After browsing TripAdvisor on what people ordered, we decided to get a pork and beef Banh mi with egg. I have to say the Banh Mi is not too bad but I don’t believed it’s that great. I guess we got spoiled back in LA where we have many Vietnamese restaurants making excellent Banh Mi. Well, it’s the experience that counts. We can claim that we visited one of the TripAdvisor popular restaurants in Hanoi.
